quote: When official traffic-control devices are erected at hazardous or congested places, a person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle in any such designated place.

activation.condition: Official traffic-control devices are erected at a hazardous or congested place and designate the place; physical source review required.

obligation.description: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle in such designated place.

timing.description: During the original period when the device is erected and governs the place.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Physical place context and official designation require original source review; no legal cutoff is inferred.

parameter_refs.name: designation_target
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: request resting vehicle body inside or outside the sourced designated polygon

parameter_refs.name: source_review_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original official device authority, content, erection, designated polygon and physical hazard or congestion review

parameter_refs.name: observed_rest_position
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original vehicle body and velocity or unknown
